findings.summary: The right-triangle formulas used abbreviated side labels that did not match the established Spanish wording.
evidence: The explanatory paragraph used lado opuesto and lado adyacente, while the formulas displayed only opuesto and adyacente.
findings.resolution: Expanded the formula labels to lado opuesto and lado adyacente.

findings.summary: The inverse-trigonometry formulas used abbreviated side labels that differed from the surrounding Spanish explanation.
evidence: The formulas displayed opuesto and adyacente instead of the established lado opuesto and lado adyacente.
findings.resolution: Aligned all three inverse formulas with the established side terminology.

findings.summary: The worked trigonometry example used shortened side labels instead of the terminology used in the explanatory text.
evidence: The example labels were opuesto and adyacente while the section consistently described the sides as lado opuesto and lado adyacente.
findings.resolution: Expanded both example labels to lado opuesto and lado adyacente.
